user.title: Greenhouse fan group
user.description: Create a shared policy, then add devices and sensor sources in this integration’s Configure menu.

threshold_entities.title: Threshold entities (names and entity IDs)
threshold_entities.description:
Integration-managed native input_number entities: use their sliders or input_number.set_value. Bounds and step are managed by this integration. Removing the group automatically removes its four entities.

{entities}

device.title: Save device settings
device.description: Name and output are required. Leave BOTH sensors blank for manual-only control; automatic control needs both sources (°C / %). Submit once to save the complete device. Cancel writes nothing. Output replacement clears the old hold/timers; the new output starts automatic evaluation with fresh timers.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm device removal
confirm_remove.description: Remove {name}? Automation stops and its hold is cleared. This does not switch the output.

error.invalid_device: Check name, existing output, and sensor class/units
error.duplicate_output: This output already belongs to this or another group
error.sensor_pair: Choose both sensor sources or leave both blank
error.storage_quarantined: Storage could not be reconciled. This group is disabled, including after restart. Input is retained. Check HA logs and follow the persistence recovery instructions; do not simply retry.
error.save_failed: Could not save. Input is retained; check HA logs and retry.
error.conflict: Settings changed. Cancel and reopen to review the current device before saving.
error.ownership_unavailable: Another group is unloaded, so output ownership cannot be verified. Load every group first.

abort.group_unloaded: This group is unloaded. Load the integration first.
abort.no_devices: No devices yet. Choose Add device first.
